concepts.name: 84 Grade 12 Aggression And Invaded Ethio
concepts.simple_definition: 84 Grade 12 aggression and invaded Ethiopia on October 3, 1935
concepts.deep_explanation: Italian colonial interest in Ethi- opia gathered a new momentum after the coming to power in Italy of Benito Mus- solini and his Fascist Party in 1922
concepts.real_example: Practical example of 84 Grade 12 aggression and invaded Ethio from page 91.
concepts.common_confusion: Students sometimes confuse 84 Grade 12 aggression and invaded Ethio with adjacent topics in Chapter 3.
concepts.simple_definition_amharic: [አማርኛ] 84 Grade 12 aggression and invaded Ethiopia on October 3, 1935 (ይህ ትርጓሜ በኢትዮጵያ የ12ኛ ክፍል ሥርዓተ-ትምህርት መሠረት የተዘጋጀ ነው)።
concepts.deep_explanation_amharic: [አማርኛ ማብራሪያ] Italian colonial interest in Ethi- opia gathered a new momentum after the coming to power in Italy of Benito Mus- solini and his Fascist Party in 1922 — ይህ ጽንሰ-ሐሳብ ተማሪዎች በክፍል ውስጥ የተማሩትን በቀላሉ እንዲረዱ ይረዳቸዋል።
concepts.real_example_amharic: [አማርኛ] በገጽ 91 ላይ ያለውን ተግባራዊ ምሳሌ ይመልከቱ።
concepts.common_confusion_amharic: [አማርኛ] ተማሪዎች ይህንን ጽንሰ-ሐሳብ ከሌሎች ተዛማጅ ርዕሶች ጋር ሊያደናግሩ ይችላሉ።

concepts.name: TextBook 85 Figure 3.11 Emperor Haile Se
concepts.simple_definition: TextBook 85 Figure 3.11 Emperor Haile Sellase appealing to the League of Nations Ethiopia had joined the League of Nations in 1923

concepts.name: 86 Grade 12 The Italian Fascist Occupati
concepts.simple_definition: 86 Grade 12 The Italian fascist occupation which lasted for five years, was largely confined to the major towns because of the nationwide patriotic resistance
concepts.deep_explanation: It was only in the towns that the Italians left behind traces of their occupation

concepts.name: 88 Grade 12 The Second Phase Of The Patr
concepts.simple_definition: 88 Grade 12 The second phase of the patriotic struggle, which was largely guerrilla warfare, be- gan soon after the Italians entered Addis Ababa, and became very strong after the Graziani massacre of 1937
concepts.deep_explanation: The February 1937 massacre was a signal for a reign of terror unleashed by the Fascist Black Shirts
